decisions.reason: Although still promoted, the accelerator program is a peripheral service for a machinery-focused recycling firm and is the likeliest candidate to be discontinued in favor of core technology and R&D priorities.
The bio-based binder remains visible on its own page and fits the firm's circular-value narrative, but its market is less central than the firm's core waste-treatment equipment business.
The infectious-waste decontamination plant is prominently featured, close to the established offer, and aligns well with the firm's modular waste-processing capabilities and growth strategy.
